narrative:
## Handover Summary — NII & Margin

NII plan approved on the flat-rate scenario, with a -25bp sensitivity documented for the Board pack.

## Key Decisions
• Mortgage margins held at 0.65% average on renewals
• Tiered corporate deposit pricing above EUR 2M introduced
• Hedge programme extended to protect FY2027 NII

## Recommendation for Fee & Commission
With NII flat, fee and insurance income has to deliver the growth. The Wealth team should validate AUM flow assumptions against fee-yield compression.

signals.title: ECB Easing Path — Deposit Rate at 2.00%
signals.excerpt: Markets price a flat deposit rate through 2026. 12M Euribor stabilised near 2.1%, ending the NII tailwind that lifted Finnish banks in 2023-24.
